videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: After promising to fix a store's roof and stack sacks of grain, Charles falls out of a tree.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: When the rest of the Walton family fails to pay attention to a personal tragedy in his life, Jim-Bob runs away from home.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: John-Boy challenges Olivia to take a night school course in art, but she gets more than she expected when the instructor kisses her.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: Mary Ellen discovers a beautiful ring in a secondhand purse she bought for a date with John-Boy's best friend.

videos.title: A Carol for Two
videos.description: New to New York, talented singer Violette takes a job as a singing waitress. Things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

videos.title: USS Christmas
videos.description: Maddie, a reporter for a Norfolk newspaper, embarks on a Tiger Cruise during Christmastime where she meets a handsome naval officer and stumbles upon a mystery in the ship's archive room.

videos.title: With Love, Christmas
videos.description: When the office assignments are distributed for Secret Santa, Melanie is excited that she was given her crush, Donovan. Donovan is so taken by the thoughtful gifts and notes, he starts to fall in love. But someone else is stealing Melanie's credit.

videos.title: Finding Father Christmas
videos.description: Three days before Christmas, a woman who has never known her father receives a clue concerning his whereabouts. She follows the trail to a beautiful New England town where she meets a handsome young man willing to help with the search.

videos.title: Engaging Father Christmas
videos.description: Ian plans what he thinks is the perfect marriage proposal at a bucolic Vermont inn, but things do not go as planned.

videos.title: Marrying Father Christmas
videos.description: Miranda Chester has happily relocated to the Northeast, where she has established her interior design business. She splits her time between Boston and Carlton Heath, a picturesque Vermont town where her fiancé, Ian McAndrick, lives.

videos.title: The Christmas Contest
videos.description: Sparks fly between a former couple as they compete in a Christmas contest to win money for the charity of their choosing.

videos.title: Christmas in Conway
videos.description: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

videos.title: The Christmas Doctor
videos.description: A doctor encounters a man from her past who brings with him a revelation that could change her life forever.

videos.title: Nantucket Noel
videos.description: Tensions rise when a woman falls for the son of a developer who wants to tear down the wharf that is home to her toy store.

videos.title: Christmas Joy
videos.description: An ambitious market researcher returns home to care for her injured aunt. She's reunited with her former crush, now a hospital administrator.

videos.title: Sound of Christmas
videos.description: Lizzie, a young piano teacher, helps a school get ready for its major Christmas fundraiser, and she has committed much of her time to planning the event. When she meets Brad, who takes an interest in her piano skills, he asks if she will teach his uninterested teenage daughter to play the piano. She begins to break through to the girl, and sparks fly with Brad, but she is shocked to find out that his interest is not solely in her playing, but in the property that houses the music school.

videos.title: 'Twas the Night Before Christmas
videos.description: A former actress takes charge of a town's annual Christmas Eve courtroom production, in which the true authorship of the famous poem "A Visit From St. Nick" is debated.

videos.title: Boyfriends of Christmas Past
videos.description: Marketing executive Lauren must learn to open her heart with the help of four ghosts of ex-boyfriends who visit her leading up to Christmas.

videos.title: A Christmas Duet
videos.description: Fate brings an ex-music duo together over the holidays, just in time for the annual Yuletide Festival.

videos.title: Sister Swap: Christmas in the City
videos.description: Two sisters find a new sense of purpose and discover what they both truly need in life during the holidays.

videos.title: Christmas at the Palace
videos.description: Katie, a former professional ice skater, is hired by the king of San Senova, Alexander, to help his daughter in a Christmas ice skating performance. As Katie spends time in the castle, she and Alex begin to develop feelings for each other.

videos.title: A Royal Corgi Christmas
videos.description: The prince's Christmas gift for his mother, a corgi puppy, turns into a disaster when the dog misbehaves constantly. He turns to an American dog trainer for assistance and sparks begin to fly.

videos.title: Christmas in Homestead
videos.description: An actress heads to the Christmas-obsessed town of Homestead, Iowa, to shoot a holiday-themed movie. She is shocked when a romance blooms with Matt, a single dad. As she gets a taste of small-town life, she discovers the true meaning of Christmas.

videos.title: A Holiday Spectacular
videos.description: In 1958, an heiress puts her high-society wedding plans on hold to fulfill her secret dream of dancing in the Radio City Music Hall Christmas Spectacular.

videos.title: Angel of Christmas
videos.description: A woman's life changes in unexpected ways when, in the process of writing a newspaper article about her family's heirloom Christmas ornament, she meets an enthusiastic artist.

videos.title: Deliver by Christmas
videos.description: Bakery owner Molly meets Josh, a newcomer in town, but is also enchanted by a mysterious client whom she's never met in person. A special wish to be delivered by Christmas could help determine who will win Molly's heart.

videos.title: Ice Sculpture Christmas
videos.description: An aspiring chef finds romance during Christmastime while preparing for an ice-sculpting competition.

videos.title: The 5-Year Christmas Party
videos.description: Told over the course of five years, two recent college grads find themselves drawn together year after year while working for a catering company that specializes in holiday parties.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Laura becomes enamored by a new student, but he expresses more interest in Mary, which breaks her heart.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Charles helps a woman stage her own wake to ensure her distant children's attendance.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Laura befriends a lonely, crippled girl (Kim Richards) sheltered by her father.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Caroline reluctantly leaves the children with a babysitter when Charles invites her on a 6-day trip to Mankato.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Substitute-teacher Caroline deals with a boy (Dirk Blocker) ridiculed for his limited literacy.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: After Laura's pet raccoon bites her and the dog, Charles and Caroline discover it is rabid.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: John-Boy's feelings of inadequacy are washed away when circumstances lead to the publishing of a book of his short stories.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: Grandpa becomes upset with John, and his stubborn pride leads him to pack, take Grandma by the hand and leave home.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: Feeling "put out to pasture," John seeks adventure by leaving to work in a Norfolk shipyard.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: The Waltons help prepare for the return of an old friend's wife, but strange circumstances surround the visit.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: Grandpa is stricken by a heart attack and is desperately despondent about his condition; the entire Walton family makes every effort to restore his will to live.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: John-Boy tries to unravel the circumstances of a hit-and-run charge brought against Ben in a nearby town.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Elizabeth is distraught over the reveal of Nathan's secret; everyone helps a couple prepare for their wedding; the bachelor and bachelorette parties stir up mixed emotions from the guests; a mysterious businessman arrives in town.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: A wedding in Hope Valley leads every couple to evaluate their relationships; Rosemary discovers there is more happening in Hope Valley than everyone realizes, and she decides to get to the bottom of it.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Landis, the school inspector, arrives in town and causes trouble for Elizabeth; Rosemary finds her calling; a search is called when one of Hope Valley's residents is lost; Carson and Faith's relationship is put to the test.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Elizabeth finally realizes who she is supposed to be with; big changes are coming to Hope Valley; the town rallies together to say goodbye and good luck to one of its own.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Change is in the air for Hope Valley, with the foundry to be built and an upcoming mayoral election; Elizabeth arrives home from a trip to Hamilton; a potential investor arrives in town to discuss the oil business with Luca.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Hope Valley elects a new mayor; Lucas and Elizabeth try to find the little moments in their relationship; Elizabeth offers to help Nathan with his horse after the hit-and-run, but it's newcomer Mei, who connects with Newton.
